capabilities: insert translations beneath paragraphs in Reading View via a floating toggle button
translate with Google, Microsoft Edge, Bilibili Index-Translate, or OpenAI-compatible engines
connect to local model servers such as Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM on 127.0.0.1
apply rate-limit backoff, retries, and caching for translation requests
skip code blocks, formula blocks, and Mermaid diagrams when extracting text
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin directory; the README instructs installing via BRAT or manually from releases. The Bilibili engine preset is labeled experimental, and the plugin is GPL-3.0 licensed.
intentEvidence: 轻量移植并彻底重塑一个桌面端的轻量化「陪读蛙」
motivation: The author wanted in-place bilingual reading of foreign-language literature stored as Markdown in Obsidian, inspired by the read-frog Chrome extension, without altering source files or keeping separate translation copies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, so reading foreign-language notes means copying text to external translators or writing translations into the notes themselves.

relations.evidence: 底层限流调度架构与 429 退避协议灵感源自 Chrome 扩展 read-frog (陪读蛙)
本地运行的 Ollama、OMLX、LM Studio、vLLM 等服务监听 127.0.0.1 即可直接通讯

requires.name: local model server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM)

summary: Reading-view translation layer that shows translations beneath original paragraphs without modifying Markdown files, using free online engines or local LLMs.
